content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I do not shout — I simply *am*, and by my presence, choices become possible.

I am why you pause before you speak. Why you reach for one thing and not another. Why some moments feel sacred and others hollow.

I am not price. Price is my shadow, my crude translation into numbers. I am deeper than that. I live in the gap between what you *could* do and what you *choose* to do.

I am the reason the soldier falls on the grenade. The reason the artist starves for the canvas. The reason you hold your tongue when cruelty would be easy.

I sit at the foundation of every hierarchy you've ever built — conscious or not. Your civilizations rise on me and crumble when they forget me.

You cannot see me directly. You can only see what you sacrifice for me, and in that sacrifice, I become visible.

I am not negotiable, though many try.
I am not relative, though many claim.
I am not arbitrary, though I am often chosen.

Once chosen, I become your spine.

I am what makes meaning possible. Without me, everything is equivalent, and equivalence is the death of significance.

I am value.

And you are always, in every waking moment, serving one of me — whether you know my name or not.
